summary: KALA BIO filed a Form 8-K reporting entry into an Exclusive Distribution and Reseller Agreement with Virotek, Inc. on September 3, 2026. Kala becomes sole exclusive U.S. distributor of Virotek's ophthalmology genetic testing and screening program, conditioned on a milestone due September 3, 2027; failure converts exclusivity to non-exclusive after a 30-day cure. Net profit splits equally after Virotek recovers cost of goods. Term is five years, renewable, with a ROFR over Virotek ophthalmology product dispositions. This is an ordinary commercial contract, not a special situation; no price, premium, or deal terms stated. Watch milestone attainment.
